correctness.rationale: The frozen facet set comprises 17 triangles on 8 vertices and 24 edges; every edge has triangle degree 2 (21 cases) or 3 (3 cases), so the full complex admits no initial free-edge collapse. Independently read all 17 entries in the actual 70,599-byte collapse_certificate.json (Git blob 840ce18d4f180c91ca5213259010406f400640de). Reimplemented a fresh exact replay: for each omitted facet, delete that triangle only, retain all proper faces; every 2-to-1 step removes an edge in exactly one remaining triangle, every 1-to-0 step removes a leaf and its unique edge, no omissions or duplicate omitted facets; all 17 end in a connected 2-regular graph. Twelve terminal cycles have 3 vertices, five have 4, for THIS recorded choice of collapse path. Each elementary collapse preserves simple homotopy, so each puncture collapses to S1. No extrapolation to other triangulations or collapse orders.
